description: Declared case list for ticket 13's public tracer-bullet scenario. Tooling input only: the testcase repository does not depend on it. Requirement IDs come from the case's own header and expected-oracle.md; the hand-derived assertion count is recorded here because the CTP SQL runner has no counter (ticket 35 F3).

cbrd_26659_oos_rep02_largest_first.assertion_count_derivation: hand-derived from expected-oracle.md revision 2: 11 scalars per row group x 2 row groups + 3 in the final aggregate + 2 INSERT affected-row counts; justified only because CTP compares the whole result text, so a byte-identical .result entails that all 27 matched

applicability.fixture: Same two rows of (id INT PRIMARY KEY, big BIT VARYING, small BIT VARYING) with the same byte patterns and sizes as the case, inserted in the same order, on a table the checker owns exclusively in its own database.
applicability.execution_path: The checker ran in a different run mode from the CTP case (declared applicability for that situation only). Same OOS operation, INSERT-side demotion; certifies no scan, recovery or vacuum path. Accepted reading of 'execution path must match' = same OOS operation, not same run mode (user decision O2, ticket 35).
applicability.engine_configuration: Same pinned engine commit and install, same page size, unmodified build, no instrumentation.
applicability.conditions: Single session, no concurrency, no fault injection, empty table at the start, no vacuum or restart in between; SHOW HEAP OOS reports per class, so exclusive ownership of the table attributes the chunk count to this fixture.
applicability.source_manifest: the manifest of the invocation that ran the checker
